correctness.rationale: The graph is specified by 14 vertices and Singer difference-set nonincidence. A complete all-16384-mask construction using two predicates yields 1116 faces. Sequential toggling constructs 553 unique Morse pairs, leaving exactly one critical 0-cell and eight critical 4-cells; a complete 4298-edge Hasse orientation is topologically sorted over all 1115 nonempty faces. Discrete Morse theory gives the integral wedge of eight four-spheres. Independent mod-two augmented boundary ranks agree. Exhaustive enumeration of the 168 part-preserving maps and 168 polarity-swapped maps checks adjacency preservation and all 336 signed simplicial Lefschetz traces. Exact character sums have inner product one and no trivial constituent. The included executable recomputes these facts; the proof makes no infinite-family extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The primary archive-era forbidden-path work and later full higher-independence family classification contain no target biplane nonincidence homotopy computation. Public graph-specific literature classifies the graph and locally isomorphic graphs, not its two-independence complex. A same-order Fano incidence graph and several other higher-independence complexes are mathematically distinct and do not imply the result. Targeted published-record and prior-claim checks returned only different complexes/parameters or general techniques; residual risk of unindexed exact coverage is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed, private or inaccessible exact two-independence computation for the co-Heawood graph may exist; search failure does not establish absolute novelty.

The eight-dimensional irreducible module may be abstractly isomorphic to an eight-dimensional module appearing in another graph complex, but such an abstract similarity would not imply the present topological theorem.

value.rationale: The co-Heawood graph is a canonical distance-regular graph: the point-line nonincidence graph of the Fano plane and seven-point biplane incidence graph. Its two-independence complex is a natural forbidden-induced-degree construction, and the nonpure facet dimensions 4,5,6 conceal the exact wedge of eight four-spheres. The complete 336-automorphism rational character is absolutely irreducible with no invariants; it is a nontrivial symmetry-sensitive topological classification, not an arbitrary isolated parameter or a Betti-number table recomputation. No unproved downstream benefit is required or claimed.
